supersedes.relation: CONCEPTUAL_SUPERSESSION; v1 JSON, sidecar, docs, harness and workflow are preserved unchanged as provenance
whatChanged: economic decision contract: the regional benchmark is an explicit outside option with expected net alpha 0
v1 minimum edge, concentration-risk multiple, trade notional, ADV floor/fraction and slippage budget removed as model blockers
probability head target is the NET event R_i - R_b > round-trip cost
opportunity rule uses the outside option's own values (0 and 0.5) against the sealed bootstrap lower bounds
tradability is a PIT traded-at-all guard over v1's 20-session window instead of an unsealed cash-ADV table
missing forward endpoints are bounded (observed-only AND worst-plausible, conjunctive) instead of voiding every date
region-year survivorship eligibility at the repository tolerance for training and evaluation
evaluation split into A absolute calibration, B direction, C probability calibration, D opportunity vs outside option, E stability
DART ownership moved from a historical overlay stub to prospective-only

horizonRationale.21: One trading month for attention/event decay, five-week overlap; no accounting head at short horizon. Price leadership is context.
horizonRationale.126: Two quarters for accounting quality and established price leadership; adequate maturity with thirteen-year source; attention is context. No third primary horizon.

benchmarkContract: regional local-currency forward accumulated total-return Close; no FX allocation/cash timing

universe.US: strictly earlier pinned dated constituent observation; upstream observation time is conservative availability, not retroactive event date
universe.KR: strictly earlier KRX monthly ranked top120 snapshot; no current-member union
universe.survivorship: keep former/delisted names present in observations; absent endpoints remain missing, never substituted; source observations do not prove complete delisting coverage

transforms.scaler: date-weighted training median and IQR; zero IQR -> 1
transforms.imputation: training median plus indicators for every active field; allmissing fields omitted per fold and logged

sampleWeighting: each training date total weight exactly 1; each name 1/n_date; bootstrap repeated clusters independently each sum 1; no normalization to row count
featureReview: v1 registry re-read against source for v2: no feature newly found PIT-unsafe. Volume is split-adjusted FORWARD from each panel's first session (price_adjustment.to_total_return), so volume ratios carry no future split; KR shareCountChangePct and sparse KR capex/FCF stay excluded exactly as v1 sealed them; no feature added

decisionContract.question: Is holding active stock i a better use of this capital than holding its own regional passive benchmark?

outsideOption.costRationale: the stock is charged its full dated round trip; the benchmark alternative is charged nothing, which errs toward the benchmark

decisionContract.grossExpectedAlpha: E[R_i - R_b(i)] from the LINEAR expected-return head (Ridge) on the gross relative-return label
decisionContract.expectedNetAlpha: grossExpectedAlpha - roundTripCost(region, signal date); exact because the cost is known at the signal
decisionContract.probabilityNetOutperform: P(R_i - R_b(i) - roundTripCost > 0) from the LINEAR probability head (Logistic) trained on beatBenchmarkNet
decisionContract.uncertainty: 5th/95th percentiles of 200 training-only moving-block refits (sampling uncertainty of each head's fitted value), inherited from v1
decisionContract.activeRule: tradable AND expectedNetAlpha > 0 AND probabilityNetOutperform > 0.5 AND expectedNetAlphaLower > 0 AND probabilityLower > 0.5
ruleDerivation: the benchmark is in the choice set with net alpha exactly 0, so the only non-arbitrary level to beat is 0

P(net alpha > 0) > 0.5 is the same comparison stated for the median: a stock more likely than not to trail its benchmark net of cost is not preferred to it; 0.5 is indifference, not a conviction cutoff
both heads must favour the stock, because expected value and probability can disagree for a skewed payoff and either disagreement leaves the default outside option in place

both must still favour it at the lower end of the sealed sampling interval, so a large point estimate the model cannot distinguish from the benchmark does not move capital; the quantile is v1's sealed 5th percentile, not chosen here and never swept
decisionContract.noActiveOpportunity: valid natural state for any region-date; capital remains in the benchmark
decisionContract.rankingRole: diagnostic only (rank IC in evidence B); never a decision input
decisionContract.portfolioLayer: SEPARATE_AND_UNDEFINED_HERE: sizing, Kelly, inverse-vol, dependence, diversification, sector and region limits, cash vs benchmark allocation are never used to decide whether a stock has alpha and are not optimised against outcomes

smallCapitalAssumption.statement: individual-investor capital; institutional scalability is NOT a requirement; opportunities too small for large mandates remain valid
smallCapitalAssumption.consequence: no portfolio value, order notional, participation ceiling or capacity model is required to research whether a stock beats its benchmark
retained: dated realistic transaction costs in net alpha
smallCapitalAssumption.notMeasuredHere: that a personal order is small relative to traded value is an ASSUMPTION about capital scale, supported by the universes being S&P 500 constituents and KRX top-120 by market cap; it is not a measured participation rate
smallCapitalAssumption.portfolioLayerObligation: before live sizing outside these universes or at larger size, an actual traded-cash-value source and participation limit are required; that is execution engineering for the portfolio layer, not alpha research

tradabilityGuard.rule: PIT universe member on the signal date AND a positive finite sealed close AND positive finite sealed share volume on every one of the 20 regional exchange sessions ending on the signal date (calendar reindex, no fills)
tradabilityGuard.windowProvenance: v1's sealed 20-session ADV window, with the unsealed cash-value requirement replaced by traded-at-all evidence
tradabilityGuard.volumeUse: share volume as traded/not-traded evidence only; never multiplied by the forward total-return Close into a fictitious cash ADV
tradabilityGuard.universeFloor: US strictly-earlier S&P 500 constituent observation; KR strictly-earlier KRX top-120 by market cap
tradabilityGuard.advRequiredForExecutionRealism: only for a future portfolio layer sizing beyond the small-capital assumption
tradabilityGuard.notAlphaInput: tradability is a filter, never a feature or a score; liquidity as predictive information would be a separate registered feature and is not one here

models.baseline: training date-weighted prevalence / training date-weighted mean relative return
models.interpretation: LINEAR primary and the only family that produces decisions; SHALLOW_CHALLENGER complementary interaction evidence only, never a decision, never a rescue, never a winner

walkForward.refit: first regional weekly signal date each calendar year; expanding history
walkForward.prediction: last regional session each calendar week
walkForward.maturity: outcomeEndDate strictly less than fold cutoff; no label merely started before cutoff
walkForward.embargo: exact endpoint maturity purge; no extra arbitrary embargo; training uses past only
walkForward.missingTrainingLabels: unresolved endpoints are excluded from TRAINING with counts; evaluation bounds them (survivorship)
walkForward.pendingEvaluation: exclude dates whose scheduled exit exceeds data cutoff; purely calendar-based, not label-quality based
walkForward.coverageGate: per-region-year minimum applies to evaluation years 2016 onward; training warmup coverage disclosed; no pre-source KR accounting imputation claim
walkForward.regionYearEligibility: training AND evaluation use only region-years whose unvouched PIT-member share is within survivorship.regionYearUnvouchedTolerancePct; measured before labels
walkForward.evaluationStart: first READY annual fold of each region x horizon cell; every later scheduled fold must be READY or the cell is DATA_INSUFFICIENT

targets.beatBenchmarkNet_H: 1 iff forwardRelativeReturn_H > roundTripCost(region, signal date) else 0
targets.entry: next regional exchange session CLOSE after information date
targets.exit: H additional regional exchange sessions after entry
targets.informationTimestamp: end of signal calendar day in regional timezone; date-only filings strictly earlier
targets.totalReturn: replay-v16 forward accumulated distributions/splits, same endpoint basis for stock and benchmark
targets.missingOrDelisted: exact endpoints only; unresolved endpoint => MISSING_FORWARD_PRICE_OR_DELISTING; never zero, forward fill, nearest date or last price
targets.implementation: alpha_opportunity_v2_evaluation.target_from_sessions (v1 target_at semantics, precomputed calendar; test-proven equal)

uncertainty.method: training moving-block bootstrap refits of both linear heads, complete date clusters; transformer refit each replicate
uncertainty.meaning: 90% sampling interval for fitted mean/probability; NOT individual return prediction interval
uncertainty.residual: past matured out-of-fold RMS of LINEAR relative-return residuals per fold; DISCLOSED as predictive dispersion for a future portfolio layer; never part of the opportunity decision
uncertainty.implementation: alpha_opportunity_v2_model.prediction_uncertainty: identical statistic to v1 (same seed, blocks, cluster weights, quantiles) from precomputed date indices; probability head refit on the NET label

transactionCostRule: repository benchmark_alpha.REALISTIC_COSTS via portfolio_validation._dated_cost_policy; roundtrip=(2*commissionBps+spreadBps+sellTaxBps)/10000 at signal date, public schedule known then; same ex-ante estimate charged in candidate diagnostics, not a realized portfolio cost simulation

costStress.use: disclosure only: opportunity level recomputed with the round trip doubled; never a gate, never used to choose anything

survivorship.toleranceProvenance: pipeline.pit_data.HISTORICAL_UNIVERSE_GAP_TOLERANCE_PCT, a prior human decision; not chosen here
survivorship.unvouched: PIT member-date without a positive finite sealed close on the signal date (absent panel or absent session)
survivorship.measuredLowerBound: docs/results/alpha-opportunity-model-v2-input-audit.json: US 2013-2016 exceed the tolerance on no-panel names alone
survivorship.treatmentRule: every predictive and opportunity gate must pass under BOTH; OBSERVED_ONLY drops unresolved endpoints, WORST_PLAUSIBLE assigns them the date's worst plausible observed relative return and net label 0
survivorship.activeLevelStress: stressedActiveNet = (1-g)*activeNet + g*(date worst plausible relative return - cost), g = unvouched share of that date's PIT members (portfolio_validation._stressed_excess at the full measured gap)

coverageGate.rule: inherited from v1; checked before labels; failure stops with BLOCKED_BY_DATA_INTEGRITY and never edits the registry

inference.multiplicity: 98.75% two-sided intervals Bonferroni across four region x horizon primary claims; within claim all gates conjunctive
inference.resampling: noncircular moving blocks of complete chronological weekly date summaries; never iid names

A_absoluteUsefulness.absoluteSlope: date-balanced pooled slope of realised on predicted gross relative return, NOT demeaned within date; lower > 0
A_absoluteUsefulness.mseImprovement: vs training date-weighted mean relative return; lower > 0
A_absoluteUsefulness.calibrationInTheLarge: mean(predicted - realised) interval, disclosed, not gated

C_probabilityCalibration.brierImprovement: NET label vs training prevalence; lower > 0
C_probabilityCalibration.ece: POOLED date-balanced ECE over v1's 10 fixed equal-width bins; upper <= maxEce
C_probabilityCalibration.perDateEce: v1's per-date mean ECE, disclosed only

eceNull.method: perfectly calibrated synthetic predictor, p ~ U(0.3,0.7), z ~ Bernoulli(p), 300 dates, seed 42 (tests/test_alpha_opportunity_v2.py::_ece_null); no market data
eceNull.reading: v1's per-date ECE gate (<= 0.05) rejects a perfectly calibrated KR-sized (120-name) model with certainty; pooling keeps the same 0.05 bound meaningful

D_opportunityVsOutsideOption.activeNet: date mean over ACTIVE names of realised (relative return - cost); conditional on dates with >=1 active; lower > 0
D_opportunityVsOutsideOption.spreadOverNonActive: same-date ACTIVE minus non-active tradable realised net; lower > 0 (lesser of level and spread)
D_opportunityVsOutsideOption.halves: point estimate of activeNet > 0 in each chronological half of evaluation dates
D_opportunityVsOutsideOption.resampling: full calendar incl. NO_ACTIVE_OPPORTUNITY dates, which contribute counts and no return
D_opportunityVsOutsideOption.notAPortfolio: equal averaging within a date summarises names; it is not a weighting, and no NAV, CAGR or Sharpe is formed

E_stability.annualFolds: >= positiveFoldFraction of annual folds jointly positive in rankIC, Brier and MSE improvement
E_stability.regions: US and KR are separate claims; never pooled; no other subgroup is examined

evaluation.dependence: moving blocks of 26 whole weekly dates, 2000 draws, seed 42, 98.75% intervals (Bonferroni over 4 region x horizon claims); within a claim all gates conjunctive and conjunctive across endpoint treatments

evidenceGates.OPPORTUNITY_EVIDENCE: A, B, C, E and D all pass under both endpoint treatments; LINEAR only
evidenceGates.PREDICTIVE_EVIDENCE_BENCHMARK_PREFERRED: A, B, C, E pass but D fails or too few active dates: predictions carry information yet do not beat the outside option net of cost
evidenceGates.NO_MODEL_EVIDENCE: adequate data, any A/B/C gate fails
evidenceGates.DATA_INSUFFICIENT: folds, dates, blocks, tails or gate inputs unavailable; any INCOMPLETE evaluation date
evidenceGates.MODEL_UNSTABLE: numerical/convergence/bootstrap failure, or A/B/C pass but annual-fold stability fails
evidenceGates.provenance: minimumEvaluationFolds, positiveFoldFraction, maxEce and minimumActiveDates (v1 minimumSelectedDates) are v1's sealed values, unchanged

ownershipOverlay.reason: bounded DART majorstock.json window 2024-09-24..2026-09-23 (2,496 events, 254 issuers); v1 calendar upper bound 98 weekly dates / 46 evaluation dates < 60 required; the endpoint cannot be extended backward
ownershipOverlay.futureUse: a later version may register a prospective test once prospective receipts accumulate; no older history is fabricated

excludedFamilies.US_MACRO: BLOCKED_MACRO_PIT: unverified per-series release/vintage availability in replay-v16; not a primary blocker after exclusion
excludedFamilies.US_DIVIDENDS: raw per-share amount precision unresolved, categorical transitions not proven robust
excludedFamilies.KR_OWNERSHIP_CORE: prospective-only overlay; excluded from historical execution
excludedFamilies.GURU_13F: separate Guru Decision Atlas track; never an alpha feature; SEC access status does not gate this study

prohibitedTuning: no hyperparameter search or model tournament
no threshold or breadth chosen by returns
no global transforms or iid row bootstrap
no probability or alpha threshold other than the outside option's 0 and 0.5
no confidence-level, bootstrap-quantile, tolerance or window sweep
no portfolio construction, sizing or allocation optimised against outcomes

removedV1Blockers.why: the outside option IS the economic edge: beating the benchmark net of cost is the bar, so a human +X% edge would be an arbitrary second benchmark; concentration risk is a sizing question for the portfolio layer

whether a stock beats its benchmark does not depend on the investor's account size; realistic spread/commission/tax stay in net alpha and a PIT traded-at-all guard stays; notional, participation and impact belong to execution sizing under SMALL_CAPITAL_ASSUMPTION
cash ADV was needed only for the participation ceiling; the tradability guard uses sealed share volume as evidence of trading, never as cash value

the rule (price >= 0.8, accounting >= 0.2 per evaluation region-year) is fixed here and is outcome-free; it runs on features alone before any label and a failure stops the run without editing the registry

v1MechanicsChanged.what: probability head target gross beatBenchmark -> NET beatBenchmarkNet
v1MechanicsChanged.why: the outside option competes net of the cost of leaving it; v1's gross event answers a different question

v1MechanicsChanged.what: gated ECE per-date mean -> pooled date-balanced ECE (same bins, same 0.05 bound)
v1MechanicsChanged.why: simulated null in evaluation.C_probabilityCalibration.eceNull: v1's statistic cannot pass for a calibrated 120-name model

v1MechanicsChanged.what: any missing matured endpoint voids the date -> bounded treatment (observed-only AND worst-plausible) with a 20% per-date tolerance
v1MechanicsChanged.why: docs/results/alpha-opportunity-model-v2-input-audit.json: 703 of 715 US weekly dates hold a member with no price panel at all, so v1's US leg could only return DATA_INSUFFICIENT

v1MechanicsChanged.what: opportunity gate hurdle -> outside-option comparison of both heads at their sealed lower bounds
selected-minus-universe -> ACTIVE-minus-non-active spread, plus absolute calibration slope
v1MechanicsChanged.why: the lesser of level and spread must clear 0; absolute usefulness needs a level-sensitive statistic

runtimePreLabelGates.note: ineligible region-years are excluded, not a stop; the stop is via calendar depth

operationalRisk: the v2 runner has been exercised on synthetic fixtures only; its first real run may stop at a pre-label gate (reported, no labels) or exceed the 360-minute hosted-runner limit (no result). Neither permits editing this spec.

expectedOutputSchema.blockedOutput: readiness metadata and reasons only; no predictions
